data.title: 中野四叶 · 操场跑道上的冲线阳光
data.description: 阳光充盈的红色塑胶跑道终点线上，四叶刚完成全力冲刺。额角微微渗着汗珠，双手比着可爱的V字胜利手势，胸口随着轻快喘息起伏，笑容耀眼。
data.action: crossing finish line, hands on knees, peace sign, sweating gently
data.lighting: bright midday sunshine, clear blue sky
data.promptProse: On a vibrant red running track under an open blue sky, Nakano Yotsuba crosses the finish line in her green-and-white athletic hoodie and gym shorts. She flashes energetic double peace signs with sweat glistening on her smiling cheeks.
data.animaCaption: Flashing a cheerful peace sign on the sunny track finish line, sweat glimmers on her smiling brow.
